author: Crimson_Aught
body:
Two days ago I saw it https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/c029e4189?reply=300276 and i was so happy because "now I can download any map to discover it".
But NO. 'Region' folders are empty for every map, there are no screens. It is just a stack of level.dats
Only yml help is there T-T
